# reco_posture_check (Resource)

Manages a Reco posture check policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reco_posture_check" "admins_without_mfa" {
  title                  = "Admin accounts without MFA"
  description            = "Flags administrator accounts that have not enrolled in multi-factor authentication."
  data_source            = "GSUITE_USERS_API"
  violation_risk_level   = "HIGH"
  violation_risk_type    = "RISK_TYPE_USER"
  default_status         = "POLICY_STATUS_PREVIEW"
  posture_unique_jsonata = "$.primaryEmail"
  posture_value_jsonata  = "$.primaryEmail"
  conditions_jsonata     = "$.isAdmin = true and $.isEnrolledIn2Sv = false"
  how_to_remediate       = "Require the administrator to enroll in 2-Step Verification."
  why_should_i_care      = "Administrator accounts without MFA are a common entry point for account takeover."
  tags                   = ["identity", "mfa"]
}

resource "reco_posture_check" "single_active_admin" {
  title                  = "Fewer than two active admins"
  data_source            = "GSUITE_USERS_API"
  violation_risk_level   = "MEDIUM"
  violation_risk_type    = "RISK_TYPE_USER"
  posture_unique_jsonata = "$.primaryEmail"
  posture_value_jsonata  = "$.primaryEmail"
  status_jsonata         = "true_count < 2"

  entities = [
    { name = "Active accounts", jsonata = "$.suspended = false" },
    { name = "Admins", jsonata = "$.isAdmin = true" },
  ]

  affected_entities_columns = [
    { name = "Last login", jsonata = "$.lastLoginTime" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_source` (String) Data source the check evaluates, e.g. GSUITE_USERS_API.
- `posture_unique_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression that uniquely identifies each tracked entity (min 2 chars), e.g. $.primaryEmail.
- `posture_value_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression returning the display value for each tracked entity (min 2 chars), e.g. $.primaryEmail.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title (min 10 chars).
- `violation_risk_level` (String) Severity of a failing posture issue: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL.
- `violation_risk_type` (String) Risk category: RISK_TYPE_UNKNOWN, RISK_TYPE_DATA, RISK_TYPE_USER, RISK_TYPE_USER_TARGET, RISK_TYPE_USER_GROUP, or RISK_TYPE_APPLICATION.

### Optional

- `affected_entities_columns` (Attributes List) Extra columns of the affected-entities table (Posture Studio "Additional Columns"). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--affected_entities_columns))
- `affected_entities_preset_id` (String) ID of the preset column set for the affected-entities table (Posture Studio "Preset Columns").
- `conditions_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression that evaluates to true when an entity violates the check. Set exactly one of `conditions_jsonata` and `entities`; the other is read back from Reco.
- `default_status` (String) Status for new instances: POLICY_STATUS_OFF, POLICY_STATUS_PREVIEW, or POLICY_STATUS_ON. New posture checks start ON, so when this is set the provider applies it with an update right after create. Read back from Reco; empty when instances have different statuses.
- `description` (String) Longer description shown in the Reco UI.
- `entities` (Attributes List) Named conditions, AND-ed together, as in the Posture Studio Entities step. Set exactly one of `conditions_jsonata` and `entities`; the other is read back from Reco. `terraform plan -generate-config-out` writes both, so remove one from the generated configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))
- `how_to_remediate` (String) Remediation guidance shown to operators.
- `status_jsonata` (String) JSONata expression evaluated over the results that returns true when the check fails.
- `tags` (List of String) Categorization tags.
- `why_should_i_care` (String) Business context explaining why this check matters.

### Read-Only

- `app_source` (String) Source application identifier (read-only).
- `id` (String) Posture check ID (stable UUID, set after create).
- `severity` (String) Severity level returned by the API (read-only).

<a id="nestedatt--affected_entities_columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `affected_entities_columns`

Required:

- `jsonata` (String) JSONata expression for the column value.
- `name` (String) Column header.


<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities`

Optional:

- `jsonata` (String) Required. JSONata expression that must be true for the entity to be evaluated.
- `name` (String) Display name shown in Posture Studio. The UI shows the JSONata when empty.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = reco_posture_check.admins_without_mfa
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```
